art_direction: clean white technical keynote with precise cyan system signals and calm engineering confidence
palette: white, pale blue, cyan, blue-green, deep blue-gray
typography: clear modern Chinese sans serif with restrained mono microtype only when supplied
materials: clean light, fine technical grid, matte surfaces and restrained cyan glow
text_layout: place conclusion text in a quiet white or pale-blue field; title treatment may be a focused statement, caption or integrated label rather than a huge headline
contrast: deep blue-gray text on white or pale blue with no signal line, node or highlight behind letters

keynote-cover.label: 技术开场
keynote-cover.summary: 用单一青蓝锚点建立系统主题，不靠满屏大标题
keynote-cover.composition: white technical keynote field with one cyan anchor and a quiet conclusion area
keynote-cover.imagery: abstract engineered surface, restrained ring or signal path; no product UI or pseudo-data

title_treatment.weight: modern sans conclusion with short support

requirements: keep a large quiet field for exact text

system-map.label: 系统关系图
system-map.summary: 用中心节点、分组和有方向的连线解释系统关系
system-map.composition: one dominant hub with grouped surrounding capabilities and a legible primary relationship path
system-map.imagery: abstract nodes, thin directional connectors, restrained geometry; labels appear only when supplied by exact_text
requirements: central node must remain visually dominant
avoid: serial pipeline when relationships are parallel

circuit-flow.label: 连续回路
circuit-flow.summary: 让节点沿一条连续路径呈现顺序、循环或状态变化
circuit-flow.composition: single continuous cyan route across a quiet technical field with clearly separated stages
circuit-flow.imagery: thin circuit-like path, abstract nodes and subtle state marks; numbers only when present in exact_text
requirements: path order or loop direction must be readable

data-overview.label: 数据概览
data-overview.summary: 用清爽分组和有限图形呈现有来源的数据关系
data-overview.composition: one readable chart or data grouping on a white field with a clear comparison baseline
data-overview.imagery: minimal technical chart geometry, dots, bars or rings; every visible number and label comes from exact_text or evidence
requirements: units and comparison dimensions stay consistent

comparison-matrix.label: 比较矩阵
comparison-matrix.summary: 用对称网格保持比较维度一致而不过度卡片化
comparison-matrix.composition: two or three aligned comparison fields with a disciplined baseline and a clear central divider
comparison-matrix.imagery: simple node clusters, aligned bars or quiet geometric fields; no interface chrome
requirements: same dimensions appear in the same order
keep equal visual weight between compared fields

signal-quote.label: 信号判断
signal-quote.summary: 一条主张或引文配合一个青蓝信号锚点
signal-quote.composition: single conclusion or confirmed quote in a quiet field with one small cyan signal
signal-quote.imagery: one line, ring or node as a restrained signal; no invented author or citation
requirements: the supplied sentence remains the sole verbal focus
avoid: author or source not in exact_text

ui-concept.label: 概念界面
ui-concept.summary: 将系统能力转成抽象界面语言，但不冒充真实产品截图
ui-concept.composition: one abstract interface-like composition embedded in a technical field with no readable invented UI copy
ui-concept.imagery: conceptual panels, states and geometry only; real product UI requires user-provided asset
requirements: mark the visual as conceptual through abstraction, not added labels
no real logo or product name

isometric-space.label: 等距技术空间
isometric-space.summary: 用轻量建筑或等距空间承载系统的场景感
isometric-space.composition: light isometric technical space with one clear pathway and a protected copy margin
isometric-space.imagery: white architectural volumes, pale-blue planes and sparse cyan signals; avoid dark neon and device advertising

title_treatment.weight: quiet sans caption or integrated conclusion

requirements: space must suggest a system, not a literal product claim
keep geometric edges out of the text field
